svg.title: Tool exchange stages and recorded tool state
svg.desc: For an exchange from tool 2 to tool 5: check readiness and rollers; approach and release tool 2; record empty and clear compensation; pick and clamp tool 5; record tool 5 and apply compensation; withdraw and return or continue. The new tool number is not the end of movement.

g.text: No exchange movement before roller confirmation.
Spindle stop, station entry and release confirmation.
Clear the old correction and await acceptance.
Approach tool 5, enter its station and confirm clamp.
Apply its correction and await acceptance.
Manual return or the approved program continuation.
Recorded state: tool 2 → empty → tool 5. Movement can continue after each update.
Read numbered stages in order. Conceptual sequence; not a scale route drawing or access permission.
